The supplied extract, attributed to the Universal House of Justice, opens with an ellipsis, calls expansion and consolidation inseparable, embeds a bracketed placeholder for the passage “Every outward thrust….” rather than its words, and then states that enriching individual spiritual life, collective consciousness of local communities and efficient institutions is as important as expansion; it ends with a stray citation, COC vol. 2 p. 65. No authority is asserted; as an incomplete composite whose central quotation is only a placeholder, omit.

No authority is asserted; keep on merit.

No authority is asserted; keep on merit.

integrationReview.decision: Keep the concrete German institutional example and the wider assurance of growth; the new general claim of rapid spread is not a clear improvement.
